title: Claude: v2 Release tag and active session revocation
summary: Published new official GitHub release tags and rolled out granular session management and billing controls across client platforms.
whyItMatters: Strengthens security posture and multi-client access control for teams using Claude across desktop and web.

title: Gamma: Credit pool restructuring across paid tiers
summary: Restructured monthly credit allowances with explicit 1,000, 4,000, and 20,000 credit packages across Pro and Plus tiers.
whyItMatters: Changes generation velocity and cost predictability for teams generating high volumes of slide decks and docs.

title: Perplexity: Fast Search API tier introduced ($5 / 1k requests)
summary: Added Fast Search option to Perplexity API pricing: Standard search in Fast Mode is now available at $5 per 1,000 requests with reduced latency.
whyItMatters: Directly impacts API cost modeling for developers integrating Perplexity search and retrieval pipelines.

title: ChatGPT: Direct drag-and-drop support for modern image formats
summary: Added native drag-and-drop upload support for .avif, .heic, .heif, and .webp containers directly on the web client.
whyItMatters: Removes client-side conversion friction when uploading mobile photos and modern web screenshots into vision models.

title: DuckDuckGo: Duck.ai private AI chat expanded to mobile
summary: Integrated private, zero-retention AI chat natively into DuckDuckGo mobile browser applications.
whyItMatters: Provides frictionless mobile access to multiple underlying models (GPT-4o mini, Claude 3 Haiku) with strict privacy guarantees.

title: Runway: Dedicated Team Plan and collaborative workspaces
summary: Introduced dedicated Team Plan pricing tier with shared workspace limits, pooled generation credits, and centralized billing.
whyItMatters: Key transition from single-seat creator plans to collaborative production pipelines for video generation.

title: Magnific: 3D 360-degree panoramic generation launched
summary: Introduced 3D 360 panoramic generation tool directly in the AI suite for immersive environment creation.
whyItMatters: Expands upscale and generative capabilities beyond flat images into spatial computing and VR workflows.

title: Viggle AI: Developer API & Documentation Portal launched
summary: Opened public developer API documentation (v1) and introduced programmatic animation endpoints for video character generation.
whyItMatters: Enables automated pipeline integration for character motion and animation outside of the Discord/web interface.

title: Example: documentation access changed for agent workflows
summary: Prototype signal showing how a material API or integration change would be summarized after snapshot comparison and source verification.
whyItMatters: A documentation provider sits directly in the context path of coding agents, so interface changes can alter reliability across every downstream run.

title: Example: a pricing or allowance change crossed the threshold
summary: Prototype record for a pricing-page diff. The live engine will attach captured before/after evidence instead of relying on vendor copy.
whyItMatters: Review automation is often embedded in team workflows; a material price or allowance change can affect the economics of every repository using it.

title: Example: browser testing gained a workflow-relevant capability
summary: Prototype signal representing a release that materially changes what can be automated, while cosmetic release-note churn would be dropped.
whyItMatters: A meaningful browser-testing capability can remove repeated manual QA work; a renamed button cannot. The materiality filter exists to separate the two.

title: Example: a security or data-handling policy changed
summary: Prototype evidence type for terms, privacy or data-handling changes that can matter more than a visible product feature.
whyItMatters: Security tooling may inspect sensitive repositories. Policy changes deserve a different level of scrutiny than ordinary UI updates.

title: Example: the underlying AI behaviour changed in a research workflow
summary: Prototype signal for a model or analysis-layer update whose effect should be checked against source material rather than trusted from marketing language.
whyItMatters: Research synthesis is only useful when evidence remains inspectable; a model change matters when it changes how claims are produced or traced.

title: Example: a new workflow entered the watchset but did not merit P0
summary: Prototype record showing that discovery and publication are separate. A new capability can be tracked without being promoted as must-know news.
whyItMatters: The value of Should Know is the rejection layer: discovery can be broad while the public feed remains deliberately narrow.
